text: February 2026: a tile roof soft wash (a low-pressure wash) at Jacobs Well. The roof was heavily stained with moss and dark marks. We diverted the downpipes away from the house and water tank, then washed the tiles clean.
alt: Before and after of the roof V-shaped ridge facing caravan. Before: Moss-stained tiled roof with a V-shaped ridge, red hose and grey cable,  in Jacobs Well
